_comment: The commander's tree. One point per level after the first; a branch is learned top to bottom. Only 'live' branches can be learned; the others show what is coming.

branches.name: Tactics
branches.text: Battlefield control: who moves first, and where.

nodes.name: First Orders
nodes.text: Before each battle, choose one of your stacks to act first in round 1, ahead of every enemy.

nodes.name: Vanguard
nodes.text: Choose two stacks to open the battle, in the order you set.

nodes.name: Battle Plan
nodes.text: Choose three stacks to open the battle, in the order you set.

branches.name: Command
branches.text: Auras: the commander's presence holds the line.

nodes.name: Banner
nodes.text: One stack gets a radius-1 aura of +2 defence.

nodes.name: Oathbound
nodes.text: Once per battle, a stack or companion cannot be wiped out this round.

branches.name: Sand
branches.text: Battle spells that move the battlefield. Once per battle each.

nodes.name: Displace
nodes.text: Push or pull a stack two hexes.

nodes.name: Quicksand
nodes.text: Hexes that slow whoever walks in.

nodes.name: Stone Wall
nodes.text: Raise a wall of hexes nobody can cross.

nodes.name: Ward
nodes.text: A stack ignores the next blow.

branches.name: The Veined
branches.text: What the obelisks teach. Opens after two obelisks.

nodes.name: Vein Sight
nodes.text: See through the fog along the veins.

nodes.name: Grave Harvest
nodes.text: Raise the lowest dead of your enemies after battle.

nodes.name: Listen Below
nodes.text: Hear what is under the map.
